map.计算 L1 和 L2 正则化对损失的惩罚项。: Compute the L1 and L2 regularization penalties on the loss.
map.L1 = λ₁·Σ|wᵢ|；L2 = λ₂·Σwᵢ²；总惩罚 = L1 + L2: L1 = λ₁·Σ|wᵢ|; L2 = λ₂·Σwᵢ²; total penalty = L1 + L2
map.L1 在 0 处不可导且梯度恒为 ±λ，会把不重要权重精确压到 0，产生稀疏解可: L1 is non-differentiable at 0 with gradient ±λ, pushing unimportant weights exactly to 0 and producing a sparse solution useful for feature selection; L2 penalizes in proportion to weight, weakening near 0, only shrinking uniformly and keeping small weights, usually more stable for generalization. Mixing both is Elastic Net.
map.L1 产生稀疏权重，L2 使权重平滑。: L1 yields sparse weights, L2 smooths weights.
map.惩罚项加入损失：L_total=Loss+λ₁‖w‖₁+λ₂‖w‖₂²，统称弹性: Add the penalty to the loss: L_total = Loss + λ₁‖w‖₁ + λ₂‖w‖₂², collectively Elastic Net.
map.L1 促稀疏(特征选择)，L2 促平滑(权重衰减)，二者互补。: L1 promotes sparsity (feature selection), L2 promotes smoothness (weight decay); they complement each other.
map.权重衰减(weight decay)本质是 L2，深度学习常用之稳定训练。: Weight decay is essentially L2, commonly used in deep learning to stabilize training.
map.Elastic Net 比单独 L1/L2 好在哪？: Where does Elastic Net beat L1 or L2 alone?
map.同时获得稀疏性与分组稳定性，尤其特征高度相关时比纯 L1 更稳健；代价是多一个超: It gains both sparsity and group stability, especially more robust than pure L1 when features are highly correlated; the cost is one more hyperparameter tuned by cross-validation.
map.权重衰减和 L2 完全等价吗？: Is weight decay exactly equivalent to L2?
map.在标准 SGD 下等价；但用 AdamW 时权重衰减与梯度解耦，实现不同、效果更: Equivalent under standard SGD; but with AdamW weight decay is decoupled from the gradient, implemented differently and working better, so it cannot be simply substituted as L2.
